preconditions.description: t is an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive, representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(n == int(n) and 1 <= n <= 10**16 for n in (line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:t+1]))
preconditions.description: Each n is an integer between 1 and 10^16 inclusive, representing the position in the sequence s.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().splitlines() == [str(s[n-1]) for n in (int(line.strip()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:t+1])]
postconditions.description: For each test case n, the output line is the string representation of the n-th element (1-based) of the sequence s, where s is constructed by repeatedly appending the lexicographically smallest triple (a, b, c) of positive integers not already in s such that a XOR b XOR c = 0.
